name: Preemptive Strike
summary: A confirmed detection from a peer federation seeds a signature match locally. When the matching attacker tx appears in our mempool, the pause lands *before* the attack contract executes.
expectedOutcome: ThreatRegistry gets a new signatureHash. Matching PendingTxEvent triggers defense-agent to submit Pause BEFORE block inclusion. Frontend shows PreemptiveStrikeEvent@1 with action="pause".

steps.text: Attacker tx appeared → Pause broadcast — attack never mined
